actual: Formal request advselpriorresreq_21397a7add6a112d0b52efc2 reached real WSL feature construction (386 dates, 7720 matured label rows) but stopped before trial 1 with ADVISORY_P0J_SELECTION_PRIOR_DEGENERATE missing selection_effective_rank, producing evidence-only bundle eda3122b9e1d42f7296af99536031eebc96e122c6be3e59d42989e16b7883b36. P0-C candidate_episode_labels.parquet freezes the same rank as selection_rank while candidate_rankings.parquet and the feature matrix use selection_effective_rank; the P0-J pipeline passes labels directly to fit_selection_rank_prior without the one-to-one rank attachment. Expected: attach and validate the frozen ranking rank against label selection_rank on exact candidate identity before training, reject missing/mismatched/duplicate rank loudly, and preserve all candidates with no fill/drop/fallback.
